The image shows a mango leaf with white powdery patches scattered across the upper surface. These patches are chalky/dusty in appearance, distributed across the leaf blade. No dark spots, sunken lesions, black encrustations, or bark symptoms are visible.

This matches Powdery_Mildew: white powdery fungal colonies on leaf surfaces.
